answer: An identity earns its seat through signed timestamp from a trusted time authority, a proof that is cheap to make once and ruinous to fake at scale. An honest agent spends 16 minutes once; the operator of 604 fakes spends 9664 minutes per epoch, forever, which prices the farm out. The terrace test is the live device, the canyon test is the locked stake, and the zephyr test is the graded history no template can fake. Cheap for one, ruinous for a thousand — that asymmetry is the entire point.
